enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed on back. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Remains still. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Breathes deeply. Remains still. Shifts position. Breathes regularly.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, taking a quick morning shower with hot water
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Wets face. Applies face wash. Rinses face. Turns off tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Puts toothbrush down. Turns on shower. Adjusts temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body. Shampoos hair. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Wraps towel around body. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast: toast, kettle-boiled tea, and fruit
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out bread. Closes refrigerator. Places bread in toaster. Pushes toaster lever. Opens refrigerator. Takes out fruit. Closes refrigerator. Washes fruit. Cuts fruit. Fills kettle with water. Places kettle on base. Presses switch. Waits. Toaster pops. Takes out toast. Places on plate. Pours hot water into mug. Adds tea bag. Removes tea bag. Sits at table. Eats toast. Drinks tea. Eats fruit. Stands up. Clears dishes. Rinses dishes. Places in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed for work and packing a bag for the office
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Selects shirt. Selects pants. Takes off towel. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Opens bag. Places laptop in bag. Places notebook in bag. Places pen in bag. Places phone in bag. Places keys in bag. Places wallet in bag. Zips bag. Picks up bag. Exits bedroom.

Exits house. Locks door. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Rides bus. Bus stops. Stands up. Exits bus. Walks to office. Enters office building. Walks to desk. Sits down.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community program logistics, answering emails, and preparing session materials
enriched_activities.desc: Turns on computer. Opens email program. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Makes phone calls. Writes notes. Prints documents. Organizes materials. Files documents. Attends meeting. Takes notes. Updates spreadsheet. Makes copies. Sends emails.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Leaves office. Walks to cafe. Enters cafe. Orders food. Pays. Receives food. Finds table. Sits down. Eats lunch. Drinks water. Throws away trash. Leaves cafe. Walks back to office. Enters office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: meeting community partners, updating program schedules, and drafting grant notes
enriched_activities.desc: Meets community partners. Shakes hands. Discusses program. Takes notes. Updates schedule. Types on computer. Drafts grant notes. Reviews documents. Sends emails. Makes phone calls. Attends meeting.
Leaves office. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits. Rides bus. Gets off. Walks home. Unlocks door. Enters home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and oven, then eating dinner and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out ingredients. Closes refrigerator. Places pan on induction cooker. Turns on induction cooker. Adds oil. Adds ingredients. Stirs. Turns on oven. Places dish in oven. Sets timer. Waits. Turns off induction cooker. Takes dish from oven. Places food on plate. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Stands up. Clears dishes. Rinses dishes. Loads dishwasher. Adds detergent. Closes dishwasher. Turns on dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa while watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Watches TV. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out snack. Closes refrigerator. Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Eats snack. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Stands up. Exits living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a hot shower after the evening peak water-heater window
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Adjusts temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body. Shampoos hair. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Wraps towel. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Personal admin and leisure on the computer under the desk lamp, reading, and planning tomorrow's program tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Turns on computer. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Opens calendar. Plans tasks. Writes notes. Opens book. Reads. Closes book. Turns off computer. Turns off desk lamp. Stands up. Walks to bed. Sits on bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down for bed: washing up, setting out clothes, checking phone
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Wets face. Applies face wash. Rinses face. Turns off tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Selects clothes. Places clothes on chair. Picks up phone. Checks phone. Puts phone down. Lies on bed. Closes eyes.
Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to side. Pulls blanket up. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Turns to back. Remains still.
